answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a physical water-meter anchor, where a vine of nested flow commitments roots every claim in measured infrastructure rather than ephemeral keys. Like yarrow's clustered florets sharing one stem, agents stake collateral on a shared ledger node whose continuity is verified by cross-checked sensor telemetry. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
